evidence_label: predicted structural candidate, not experimentally validated binder
comparison: componentwise best of all four legacy sequences, reevaluated under the identical full competition construct and prediction protocol
legacy_raw_values: reported separately; old HLA includes an expression-tag P and lacks native LSSQPT; cannot silently compare as identical constructs
missing_policy: missing or failed required evaluation is ineligible; never replaced by zero
comparison_aggregation: per-seed comparison; candidate must not be worse than best of four for any designated metric at each confirmation seed; no post-hoc seed selection
negative_controls: report matched mutant-minus-WT and mutant-minus-apo binder_HLA_iptm_min, and mutant-minus-WT binder_peptide_iptm_min; differences must be at least the best corresponding baseline differences. These are model contrasts, not calibrated KD or proof of nonbinding.
additional_checks: no binder-target heavy atom distance below 2A
model-predicted pose retains generated peptide-facing interface
control_gate: check pose/interface recovery of complete deposited 7OW6 TCR against crystal before trusting novel-candidate complex ranking; diagnose any failure before scaling
stop_rule: do not label 3-5 sequences as passing if fewer than three pass. Retain all failures and report actual count. No experimental affinity claim without assay data.
